confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge; not checked against live listings or booking pages. No supplied comparable is near Tel Aviv's price level, so the level is extrapolated. Accommodation (July peak season) and cocktail/wine are the least certain. Cocktail and wine were set from the local beer relationship because direct knowledge is weaker. FX: the 15 Oct 2026 USD value was read from search-result text, not the RBA table, and was not independently confirmed; search text also showed 0.7002 for 14 Oct. Verify on rba.gov.au before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No supplied comparable is at Tel Aviv's price level. Amman, Rio and Cairo were used only as lower-cost references. Tel Aviv is set above all three in every supplied category, with tier ordering kept (dorm < private hostel < basic hotel < three-star).
